dsh-tmuxctl 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。掌控你的 tmux 面板：list/send-keys/capture、在面板中运行长任务并 watch，破坏性命令需审批。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8bfbadd72cdd8ddbd082.html
posts.en:
dsh-tmuxctl is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Take control of your tmux panes: list/send-keys/capture, run long jobs in a pane with watch mode, and approval-gated destructive commands.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8bfbadd72cdd8ddbd082.html
